Name in Other Languages

Korean

스위트펀치 단독 콘서트
(seuwiteupeonchi dandog konseoteu)

“ Knock away the bad with our Sweet Punch! „

Sweet Punch Solo Concert (Korean: 스위트펀치 단독 콘서트, seuwiteupeonchi dandog konseoteu) is Strawberry Stick Cookie's first costume, released in the first half of the Sweet School Band update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

A couple of years have passed since the Sweet Punch began as a student band, and they're finally holding their first solo concert! Strawberry Stick Cookie has been working hard to write new songs especially for the upcoming show. Everyone's got to go home with sugary sweet smiles!

Trivia

  • Sweet Punch Solo Concert was released alongside  Little Deviant,  Purple Dip, and Unknown: strawbstick c1.
  • Sweet Punch Solo Concert, as well as  Little Deviant,  Purple Dip, Unknown: strawbstick c1,  Train Conductor, and  Train Attendant, used a different name format, having the name of the costume come before the costume owner, i.e, Sweet Punch Solo Concert Strawberry Stick Cookie.
    • This error was fixed in the subsequent update.
